title: Diagnostics Companion: Contextual Retry Suggestions & Payload Snapshot Card
creator: Lina Chen
description: Design a compact, contextual Diagnostics Companion pane in the Redwood Console that surfaces targeted retry recommendations for failed requests along with a privacy-aware payload snapshot card. The companion should live as an optional docked right rail on request detail pages and provide: (1) a Retry Suggestion Ribbon with rationale and estimated success probability, (2) a Payload Snapshot Card that auto-redacts sensitive fields but preserves schema for debugging, (3) aggregated retry metrics (success rate, avg latency delta), and (4) links to run a safe simulation or open a guarded retry flow for authorized users. Goal: reduce time-to-action for engineers and PMs when triaging failed requests while avoiding accidental replay of PII or customer data.
acceptance_criteria: Diagnostics Companion visible as togglable right rail on Request Detail > Failed Requests
Retry Suggestion Ribbon displays suggestion type (quick-retry, parameter-tweak, route-fallback), short rationale, and a confidence score
Payload Snapshot Card shows a concise JSON schema preview (first 3 keys + example values) with redaction markers and a link to view full payload in an audit-only modal (requires permission)
One-click 'Queue Safe Retry' action opens an authorization gating modal and logs the action to audit trails; action is disabled for requests flagged with PII by static detectors
Design includes microcopy describing privacy defaults, retry cost estimate, and expected behavior on success/failure
Accessible keyboard interactions for ribbon buttons and companion controls; meet AA contrast for all UI elements
design_decisions: Docked right rail chosen over modal to preserve request context and allow side-by-side comparison with original logs
Show confidence score (0-100) computed by backend classifier; we display it as an ordinal band (Low/Medium/High) with tooltip containing breakdown
Payload snapshots are truncated to 1KB by default and show schema-first view to avoid overwhelming users
Redaction will be default for any detected PII; designers to show an explicit 'Request full payload (audit-only)' CTA that opens a separate modal requiring elevated permission
Retry actions are optimistic in the UI (immediate enqueue feedback) but rely on backend response for final confirmation and are surfaced in the request timeline
tradeoffs: Modal replay vs. queued retry: modal is simpler but breaks context; queueing requires server work and extra audit checks but preserves workflow continuity
Showing more payload increases debugging speed but raises compliance risk; choose conservative redaction and easy opt-in audit path
Providing automatic retry suggestions risks noisy or incorrect guidance; we limit to suggestions with >= 60% confidence and label all heuristics clearly
